  > *"These Terms of Service ('Terms') govern your access to and use of Code Fundi's websites, applications, APIs, and related services (collectively, the 'Services') operated by Code Fundi ('we', 'us', or 'our')."*

  > *"This End User License Agreement ('EULA') is a legal agreement between you and Code Fundi for any Code Fundi software we make available for installation on your devices ('Software')... Code Fundi and its licensors retain all right, title, and interest in the Software."*
* **Privacy Policy (`codefundi.app/privacy`)**:
  > *"This Privacy Policy explains how Code Fundi ('we', 'us') collects, uses, discloses, and protects information when you use our websites, applications, APIs, and related services (the 'Services')."*
